name: robinhood-agentic-trading
description: LIVE trading: Specialized AI Agents (Backtester Agent & Broker Agent) for automated daily stock screening and live execution in the Robinhood Agentic (MCP) account via the Robinhood Trading MCP (https://agent.robinhood.com/mcp/trading). Supports phased modes LIVE_SHADOW, LIVE_APPROVAL, LIVE_AUTONOMOUS. Sandbox simulation lives in the separate 'robinhood-sandbox-trading' plugin.
